scope.boundary: This sidecar covers only strict accepted COL26.8 species descending from the exact Amoebozoa root 622B2. ITIS 2026-08-26 has no exact Amoebozoa root; narrower or broader ITIS roots are intentionally not substituted.

rootBoundaryAudit.decision: No exact ITIS Amoebozoa root exists in the pinned export. No Amoebida, Rhizopoda, Protozoa or other nearby root is used as a taxon substitute.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: Unavailable: the pinned ITIS export has no exact Amoebozoa root from which to derive a current-species partition.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: Unavailable: no exact ITIS Amoebozoa root exists in this release.
statuses.ambiguous: Unavailable: no exact ITIS Amoebozoa root exists in this release.
statuses.unmatched: The exact COL Amoebozoa name has no candidate in the empty exact ITIS Amoebozoa index.

exactMatching.prohibited: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered, package-wide or taxon-substituted matching is used.

evidenceBoundary.en: This CC0 ITIS sidecar is a frozen exact-name audit for the declared COL26.8 Amoebozoa partition. Because the pinned ITIS export has no exact Amoebozoa root, all COL rows remain explicitly unmatched and no ITIS-only rows are asserted. It is not a global amoebozoan checklist, final classification authority, phylogeny, species-concept equivalence assertion, biological dossier or scientific-review record.
evidenceBoundary.zh: 此 CC0 ITIS 侧车是 COL26.8 Amoebozoa 分区的冻结精确名称审计。由于固定 ITIS 导出中不存在精确 Amoebozoa 根节点，所有 COL 行均明确保留为 unmatched，不声明 ITIS-only 行；它不是全球变形虫类名录、最终分类权威、系统发育、物种概念等同性声明、生物档案或科学审查记录。

colUsageIdLocator.stableAddressing: Binary-search non-overlapping inclusive colUsageId ranges; one detail query loads exactly one immutable JSONL gzip shard.

upstreamOnly.stableAddressing: No exact ITIS Amoebozoa root exists in this release, so the upstream-only partition is an explicit empty immutable JSONL gzip shard.
